name: FinCrime Control Lab
journeys: Use TypologyIQ: pick a firm type, product, customer type and risk theme, view results, open one typology's detail page
Use the Screening Control Designer end to end and check the results page makes sense for the inputs
Start a new product risk assessment (/assess/product-risk/new) and work through as many of the 8 steps as possible, including going back a step and refreshing mid-flow
Try to download a PDF from a free tool: check the email gate validates bad emails
Create an incident and a control test in the workspace, then check they appear on /workspace and /govern/dashboard
